text: dsh-support-lifecycle-proof 是面向 DSH 的离线支持生命周期证据核验插件，通过 tools 接口提供清单检查与验证。它检查给定清单中的哈希绑定、支持与退役时间顺序、审阅者差异、回执唯一性、证据新鲜度及零未支持闭环，并可将脱敏结果写入明确指定的工作区目录并回读校验。适合需要核对已提供发布支持窗口和退役材料的维护者；它不会自动扫描兼容性或查询部署。需要 Node.js 22 及以上版本，不需要额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-support-lifecycle-proof verifies supplied DSH lifecycle manifests offline, checking hashes, chronology, reviewers, receipts, freshness, and closure. It can write and read back a redacted report in a chosen workspace directory. Node.js 22+ is required; no key or external service is needed.
想离线核对一份发布支持周期和退役材料是否闭环
怎样验证支持清单里的哈希、时间顺序和回执是否一致？
需要把给定的生命周期证据检查结果保存成可复核的报告
dsh-support-lifecycle-proof 的功能「检查生命周期清单」：输入清单 JSON，检查字段、哈希、支持期限、退役回执和闭环条件，并返回是否闭环及各项检查结果。
dsh-support-lifecycle-proof 的功能「写入并复核报告」：提供清单路径和工作区内的产物目录后，验证清单并写入内容寻址的脱敏报告，再回读文件确认内容一致。

dsh-support-lifecycle-proof README · dsh-support-lifecycle-proof：**Maintainer / Author: He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen) · [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)**
Offline deterministic verifier for a supplied release support-window and retirement manifest. It checks hashes, release bindings, support/retirement chronology, reviewer diversity, receipt uniqueness, freshness, and an explicit zero-unsupported closure.

dsh-support-lifecycle-proof README · dsh-support-lifecycle-proof：It does **not** scan compatibility, query deployments, announce end-of-life, perform retirement, authenticate receipt issuers, prove inventory completeness, or provide operational/legal advice. Reports are redacted, content-addressed, and only written below an explicit artifact directory.
